games.title: Tipping Point
games.description: One small hero and one number. Little helpers walk in from both sides and multiply it, the weather takes from it and knocks the helpers out. The number sinks, hovers, gets a false hope or two, and then the growth runs away to 99,999,999 and the hero fills the frame. Seven scenes (campfire, snow cabin, desert sprout, snowman, lighthouse, city power, cloud), four rule sets including a duel, and four endings.

controls.label: Your own text at the top

games.title: Ricochet Rally
games.description: Squares ricochet through a board of rooms and corridors while a flood sweeps in behind them. Stripes give way after a few knocks, numbered blocks lose one with every hit, and in the squeeze between flood and gate the hits turn into a rattle until the gate gives way. Race to the checkered line or fight for the knife: the last square standing wins. Six seeded boards, six kinds of gates, spikes, skull tiles, boost pads, cloning apples, your own photos on the squares.

games.title: Spiral Shatter
games.description: A ball is thrown into a spiral full of glass. It smashes its way round until its energy is gone, the glass grows back, and the next try starts with one thing changed: the shape, the object, the speed, the size or the glass. The last try always reaches the centre and sets off the finale. Six kinds of glass, five series, nine palettes and four endings.

games.title: Ribbon Fold
games.description: A real 3D ribbon folds on a plate: every fold copies the whole ribbon, lifts the copy and swings it about the end, so the pieces double (2, 4, 8 ... 4,096) while the camera pulls back. Will it fit? At the end more ribbons turn in around the start without a single overlap, a wave runs along it, or it folds back into one strip. Glossy plastic, chrome, neon, glass or pearl on nine stages, with a rising note for every fold.

options.label: Slow orbit and a light sweep

games.title: Fold Groove
games.description: A paper strip that folds to the beat. The game writes its own 808 track for every video, and every bass hit copies the strip and swings the copy open, doubling it into dragon-curve lace. Fills fold it back, every drop slams a new shape in, and the last hit spins the figure into a pinwheel. Flat paper-cut, poster, retro, ink and chalk looks.

games.title: Fold Fractal
games.description: Fold a glowing strip in half again and again and open every crease to the same angle: each fold copies the whole line and swings the copy about its end, so the layers double until a dragon curve appears. Start from a strip, a T, a wave or a lightning bolt, fold at 90, 108 or 120 degrees, left or right, up to 26 times, then let two or four dragons meet at one corner, fill the screen, or unfold it all again. Every fold plays the next note of a rising scale.

games.title: Formula Towers
games.description: Which formula grows faster? Every tower has one: n³ against n!, 2ⁿ against 10n², any pair you like. In a real 3D scene the balls of each tower smash their way down through glass platforms, or the towers fill up with blocks to a goal line, and level after level the formulas decide how many balls there are and how hard they hit.

games.title: Shape Merger
games.description: Six original multiplying-ball and polygon crusher simulations with tunable physics. The clip ends when the container bursts.

games.title: Crush Machine
games.description: One ball in a circle with a steel crushing machine. Every time the machine slams shut, the balls caught in the gap multiply and squirt out in a new colour, until the whole circle is full. Ten machines, eight scenes, eight colour sets, six ball styles.

games.title: Stair Sonata
games.description: A song played on staircases: every voice gets its own stairs, every note is a step, and a ball lands on it exactly when the note sounds. Long notes are long steps, quick runs are tiny ones, and a voice that pauses goes dark until it joins in again. Pick a public-domain classic, an original or a polyrhythm, or load your own MIDI file.

options.label: Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairy

games.title: Hive Burst
games.description: A wall of small glass tiles, coloured in rings, with one ball in a hole in the middle. A tile cracks on the first touch and breaks on the second, and every broken tile frees another ball, so the hole grows into a glowing wave until the whole frame is bouncing balls. Chain reactions, colour bursts, a colour race, six tile shapes, fifteen colour patterns including your own word, six boards, gravity and six sound sets.

controls.label: Word for the "Your word" pattern (| = new line)
Caption (empty = automatic, | = new line, - hides it)

games.title: Sync Fountain
games.description: A polyrhythm you can watch. Glowing balls ride arcs, hop out of a fountain, bounce in glass pipes, drip onto tuned wine glasses or swing as metronomes, and each one rings a note at the moment it touches. Every ball makes a whole number of trips per loop, so the pattern drifts apart and lines up again exactly at the end: a perfect loop.

controls.label: Trips of the slowest ball (0 = auto)

games.title: Phase Loop
games.description: A pendulum wave of glowing dots. Each dot runs its own closed path a different whole number of times per loop and rings a chime when it passes the trigger, so one neat line unfolds into spirals and rosettes and then lines up again exactly. Eleven path families, ten looks and six instrument kits; every clip is a perfect loop.

games.title: Star Beats
games.description: A ball bounces inside a ring and draws a new star every bar. Every bounce is a note that lands exactly on the beat, every star ends on a chord, and layer by layer the bounces grow from single hits into a full track. Also a climb to bigger and bigger stars, a choir of balls that builds one chord, and a band where every ball is an instrument. Original synthesized sound; tempo, key, chords, instruments, arenas and looks are adjustable.

controls.label: Caption line 1 (empty = automatic, - hides it, *word* = highlight)

games.title: Every Bounce
games.description: A ball or a block bounces inside an outlined arena and leaves a copy of itself on every frame, so its whole path stays on screen as a rainbow ribbon. Every bounce changes it: bigger, faster, both or smaller, until it fills the arena or the picture breaks into loose stamps. Also a black hole that keeps pulling harder, two to four shapes that collide, seven shapes, seven arenas, ten looks, a tune played by the bounces.

controls.label: Caption (empty = automatic, | = new line, - hides it)

games.title: Digit Duel
games.description: Balls duel with maths. Each ball bounces in its own box on a stack of health layers (1.000, 10.000.000.000, 1.000.000.000.000.000) and every touch takes its damage off the top one. The damage follows the ball's rule: Fibonacci, factorial, doubling, primes, digits of pi, dice, speed, gravity, grow, split, laser or bomb. First through every layer wins. Duel, 4-way race, tournament match with bracket, or a full 4-ball cup.

games.title: Wobble Stack
games.description: Soft falling blocks in a real 3D cabinet. Tetris-style pieces drop one by one, land crooked, bounce, lean on each other and wobble into the wall by themselves: every move is simulated soft-body physics. Then a press squashes the pile until the blocks burst out onto the floor. Pick jelly, fur, steel or a mix of materials, each with its own physics and sound. Switch on line clears, change the scene, the pieces, the camera and the ending, and put your own text on the engraved sign.

games.title: Line Arena
games.description: Balls fan coloured lines to the rim of a shrinking ring. Touch a rival line to steal it, or cut it and bounce off the wall to regrow. Flags, football and basketball line-ups, tech rivals or your own photos, with fourteen scenes and eight on-screen layouts.

controls.label: Slow motion on the last knockout

games.title: Roll Hopper
games.description: A ball hops across the notes of a glowing piano roll and plays the song: every landing is the next note, exactly on the beat, and the key lights up on the keyboard. The roll is generated from the tune, so rests become long arcs and chords flash together. Pick a public-domain classic or an original, or load your own MIDI file.

games.title: Pressure Clash
games.description: One ball against a crowd, with a sliding wall between them. Every time the challenger hits a wall it splits, so its side fills up and pushes the wall back. Whoever pushes the wall past their line wins. Side-by-side or stacked with gravity, six ball styles, eight scenes.

games.title: Eureka Lab
games.description: A question on top, a glowing little experiment that answers it, and the answer in yellow at the end. Nine experiments: mirrors that catch every ball, chain reactions that run out and back, orbits that draw a flower, rings that line up again, bounces that draw a star and an edge that never ends. Each has six layouts, eight scenes and its own sound.

games.title: Melody Bounce
games.description: A ball plays a song: every pad it hits sounds the next note, exactly on the beat. The level is generated from the tune, so short notes make tight zig-zags and rests make long flights. Pick a public-domain classic or an original, or load your own MIDI file.

games.title: Shatter Stack
games.description: One to four chambers race side by side or in a grid. Balls bounce on a stack of numbered glass tiles: every touch takes one off, and each broken tile pays that chamber its bonus (×2 balls, +15 balls, double power, more speed …) while the ceiling keeps coming down. Race, squeeze, sabotage, spike-ceiling and 20-second sprint modes, eight scenes, seven number ladders.

games.title: Perfect Swish
games.description: Balls fall in growing waves onto a curved floor, bounce, and drop into a hoop while a counter adds them up. Choose where the hoops stand, how the balls are released and how the floor is built: a smooth mirror or separate tilted pads.

controls.label: Mirror the court left to right

games.title: Chomp Tank
games.description: A snap-shut mechanism sweeps a sealed tank of drifting balls: every ball it bites turns into several balls of a new colour, the counter climbs and the tank bursts at the target. Six mechanisms (hinged jaws, clapper mouth, scissor cross, triple star, sliding press, wall trap), ten jaw designs, eight scenes, five tank shapes and seeded random layouts; original synthesized sound.

games.title: Pocket Slam
games.description: A roulette hammer spins in a gear-shaped arena, stops on a pocket and slams it. Balls caught in the pocket multiply, grow, shrink, change shape or vanish, depending on the pocket. After the last slam the arena cracks and bursts.

games.title: Marble Machine
games.description: A marble machine: a hopper feeds small marbles into a chain of counter-weighted cups. Each cup fuses the marbles it catches into a bigger marble of the next colour and tips it onto the next contraption (loops, a ring jump, a funnel, wave tubes, a trampoline and more) until the rainbow marble lands in the bowl. Pick one of several machine layouts or roll a random mix.

games.title: Glass Gauntlet
games.description: A ball is trapped between a wall that never stops and a row of numbered glass blocks. Every touch takes one hit off the block in front of it; at zero the glass shatters and the next, tougher block is up. The pocket keeps shrinking, so the bounces blur into a rattle. Will the ball break the last block and slip out through the exit, or get pinned? Ten corridor layouts, seven number rules, eight scenes.

games.title: Chaos Cutter
games.description: A chaotic multi-link pendulum swings a spinning blade through a target. Every pass carves out the swept path and whatever sat above the cut shatters, while the pivot lowers and the arms extend until nothing is left. Choose from 30 targets (shapes, pictures, your own word or photo), 17 materials, five destruction styles and up to three pendulums.

games.title: Blob Escape
games.description: Jelly blobs hop through a maze toward the flag while a flood rises behind them. Pickups make a blob big for a few seconds: strong against numbered blocks, too wide for narrow openings. Eleven hand-built mazes plus seeded random ones, three rule sets, eight scenes and original synthesized sound.

games.title: Ball Slide
games.description: Marbles slide down a tower of alternating neon ramps. Two that meet at a ramp lip merge into a bigger marble of the next colour, tier by tier, until the rainbow marble forms in the bowl. A second rule set rolls one steel ball through self-healing glass pillars and multiplies its weight with every break.

games.title: Flag Atlas
games.description: Glowing balls bounce inside a real map and light up, switch off, paint or conquer its flags. Six formats: light up every flag, which flag stays last, which flags survive the timer, border paint (hard mode hides the borders), two-team takeover and empire conquest, on continents, countries and regions.

games.title: Sort Spectrum
games.description: Watch sorting algorithms put a rainbow back together. Pick up to eight sorts from 47 (Quick, Merge, Heap, Radix, Bogo, Tim, Bitonic, Gravity, Stooge, Patience, Strand, Slowsort, Sleep Sort…), one of 19 shapes (Wheel, Spiral, Sunburst, Galaxy, Tiles, Hilbert, Helix…), colours, element count, start order and speed. Every operation plays a note pitched by its value; a sweep confirms the sorted result. Battle mode races two to four algorithms and shows the finishing order.

games.title: Algo Arena
games.description: Search algorithms battle for territory on a carved arena. Each round every contestant takes one cell touching its own; a stuck team may capture a dominated enemy cell; when nobody can move, the smallest team is removed and its cells reopen. Last algorithm standing wins.

games.title: Will My PC Explode?
games.description: Balls orbit a neon ring arena and multiply at x2 / x5 / x10 gates while a glass field shatters into shards, until the flood of balls explodes the screen. Ring, U-lane and spiral arenas; neon, rainbow, face and coin balls; cycling-hue rim; original synthesized sound.

games.title: Pulse Bloom
games.description: Glowing balls bounce inside a neon rainbow ring while a red x2 badge orbits it. Every ball that strikes the badge spawns another ball and fires a ring-wide bokeh burst; every bounce sprays sparks and plays the next note of an original tune. Deterministic from the seed; ends when the target number of balls is reached.

games.title: Spin Loop
games.description: A dot-cloud sculpture spins on black in a perfect loop — the spinning-figure illusion where your brain can flip the direction. Pick a subject (dancer, fox, helix, wire cubes, your own text…), the dot grain, colours, spin mode and loop length; every clip is seed-driven and loops frame-exact.

games.title: Chime Chamber
games.description: Nested polygons, one ball each, all sharing the same lap time: every corner is a note, so a 12-gon, hexagon, square and triangle build a hypnotic 12:6:4:3 polyrhythm that layers in, breaks down to a bass solo and builds back. Original synthesized voices, scales, arrangements, palettes and shapes are all customizable and randomizable.

games.title: Brawl Royale
games.description: Original ability balls duel in a square neon arena: hook ropes, ricochet bullets, laser walls, snake venom, vampire bites, spider webs, bomb charges and frost shards chip HP pills down until one ball is KO'd. Overtime multiplies damage, then a sunburst winner card asks who should fight next. 1v1, free-for-all or team gauntlet.

controls.label: Ball names (comma separated, blank = ability name)
Keep spent hook ropes as trails
Caption under the arena (blank = seed line)

games.title: Brick Build
games.description: An original brick-vehicle speed-build: real studded elements (plates, tiles, slopes, curved fenders, clear glass, wheels) slide along a conveyor queue and snap into a generic car on a flat matte studio floor under one soft sun, with a slow orbit and a hero reveal. Eight original vehicles, nine colour schemes, nine floor tones, four supply styles.

games.title: Neon Ball Doubler
games.description: Glowing balls double every time they pass a neon ring inside an outlined arena, drawing rainbow tracer fans and synchronous wave fronts. Mirror-catch and chain-reaction modes, twelve arena shapes, palettes and sound sets.

games.title: Stick Race
games.description: Stick figures sprint through a procedurally generated obstacle course of themed zones until one survivor finishes. Style presets switch the whole look: classic night, storybook castle or kitchen, 3D plaza worlds and arcade stadium.

games.title: Silhouette Fill Loop
games.description: A glowing silhouette outline fills with multiplying balls, soft bodies, liquid, sand, bubbles or beads. They fuse into a swirling fill, shrink back into the first ball and the clip loops without a seam.

games.title: Ring Escape
games.description: A small ball bounces inside up to 150 rotating concentric rings and slips out through each gap while the camera zooms out. Ring shapes, colour styles, rotation patterns, trails, sound sets and a 1-3 ball race are all adjustable and randomizable.

games.title: Satisfying Ploughing
games.description: A tractor pulls a wide implement across a field in neat passes seen from a high chase camera. Crop turns into dark furrowed soil with crisp edges, headland turns, wind turbines, trees, roads and a river nearby.

games.title: Isometric Ball Wave
games.description: A layer of glossy balls on a mirror platform drops and bounces; distance-delayed gravity and bounciness sweep the layer through cones, funnels, vases, domes and rings, with a soft tick for every landing.

games.title: Polygon Arena
games.description: Bouncing agents inside a regular polygon arena in six modes: paint and become, split into four, fill and grow, steal a side, add a side, push out.

games.title: Bounce & Fill
games.description: A ball bounces inside a circular arena. Every wall hit grows a bump of material on the wall and shrinks the ball until the arena is a seamless filled disc. Twelve procedural materials, geode and melt modes, up to four balls.

controls.label: Caption
controls.default: Every bounce SHRINKS the ball and GROWS the wall

controls.label: Speed gain per bounce, geode mode (px/s)

games.title: Corner to Wheel
games.description: A polygon tumbles down a long slope. Every bump chips off a corner and adds a side until the shape rolls as a smooth wheel. Ten looks, rainbow or custom colours, physics sliders, races on up to six lanes.

controls.label: Caption (line one | line two)
controls.default: Every bump chips off a CORNER|Can it turn into a WHEEL?

games.title: Pistol Duel
games.description: Recoil-propelled cartoon guns hop around a dark room, firing tracers, bouncing off ledges and shooting crates for power-ups. The last team with a gun standing wins.

games.title: Blueprint Builder
games.description: A floor-plan card with dimensions, then a blocky builder raises the house block by block in real 3D, finished with a reveal orbit.

games.title: Beat Ball
games.description: Autonomous top-down 2D football: two bot teams of circle players with initials and name labels play on a striped pitch with a trailing ball, kick effects, goals, a scoreboard and a following camera. Deterministic from the seed; ends at the goal target or the match clock.

games.title: Bouncing Ball Arena
games.description: Original cartoon fighters bounce around an arena under real gravity, grab weapons and apples, and battle until one is left standing. Their faces react: cheeky or evil when armed, scared, sad or angry when hit. Includes duels, a giant boss, zombie outbreaks, a closing ring and a link race.

games.title: Voxel Builder
games.description: Carve a mountain hideaway or clear a cottage hillside, then build furnished rooms and gardens block by block in real 3D.

games.title: Egg Simulation
games.description: Five original egg physics studies with fifteen layouts: successive weighted elastic rounds, flexible jelly barriers, multiplying presses, guided tracks, growing steps and accumulating vessels.

games.title: Ball Barrier Race
games.description: Two lanes race down numbered barriers or floor columns: power vs crowd, 1 ball vs 1,000 balls, or 5 balls vs 1 accelerating ball. Neon, nebula, midnight and paper looks.

controls.label: Opening caption
controls.default: Pick a side in the comments

games.title: Marble Race
games.description: Seeded 3D marble race with collidable wooden teeth, slalom islands, ribbed lanes, rings, drops, half-pipes, glass tubes, stairs and spinners. Adjustable real sphere physics, procedural relief wood and shaded cumulus artwork, subtle depth contact occlusion and distant focus, smooth chase camera, standings and original synthesized sound. Ends shortly after the winner crosses the line.

games.title: Fruit Merge
games.description: Watch colorful fruits combine and evolve until the crowned final form. Customize containers, styles, physics and merge sounds; the video ends on its own.

controls.label: Video title
controls.default: will the fruit merge into final form ?

games.title: Musical Path
games.description: Turn your music into a colorful journey through a flowing path. Customize your cast, tempo, colors and turns, then create a portrait video.

games.title: Tiny Trials
games.description: A league of little glossy guys plays one event per clip — Cone Grab (first to bank the cones, stealing allowed), Dodgeball (last one standing in the court), Red Light Green Light (creep to the line, get caught and you are out) or Hot Potato (pass it before it blows). Season standings, a crown for the leader, powers, pop-up reactions, a giant winner card and an optional season leaderboard. Pick the event or let the dice choose; every run ends with one decided winner.

controls.label: Next game teaser after the win

games.title: Gate Rush
games.description: Two to four coloured pawns race across a grid to the crown (or the far edge) while each player spends a limited stock of two-cell walls to block rivals without ever sealing anyone in. Replay-style pacing with fast-forwarded travel, six board looks, close-up camera cuts, adjustable wall aggression, skill and showboating.

games.title: Note Dial
games.description: A ball plays a song on a numbered dial: every pitch is one point and every note is one hit, exactly on the beat. The dial is built from the tune, so quick notes are short hops along the edge and rests are long flights through the middle. Pick a public-domain classic or an original, or load your own MIDI file.

games.title: Orbit Notes
games.description: A song played by orbiting lights: every note is a node on a ring, and it sounds the instant a runner reaches it. The tune circles on the inner ring while bass and chords join on outer rings as the music builds. Pick a public-domain classic or an original, or load your own MIDI file.

options.label: Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairy

games.title: Score Sparks
games.description: Glowing balls play a page of sheet music: each one lands on the next note head exactly when that note sounds, and the notes light up and cool behind it. The page is engraved from the song, so chords land together and rests become long flights. Pick a public-domain classic or an original, or load your own MIDI file.

options.label: In the Hall of the Mountain King

games.title: Bounce Jukebox
games.description: A ball bounces inside a neon ring, and every bounce lets the song play on for a moment before it stops again, so the music only moves while the ball keeps hitting the wall. The ball grows with each bounce until the song runs without a break. Pick a public-domain classic or an original, or load your own MIDI file.

options.label: A piece of the song per bounce

games.title: Piano Rain
games.description: A piano that plays itself: every note falls as a bar of light and strikes its key exactly when it sounds, with rigged 3D hands that finger every note. Pick a public-domain classic or an original, or load your own MIDI file with every track and both hands. Flat or 3D highway view, seven instruments and many looks.

games.title: Beat Press
games.description: One ball, one press, one beat. Metal arms, pistons or an iris gate shut on every hit of the music, and each press multiplies the balls and gives them a new colour, until thousands fill the arena on the last drop. The track is written by the game for every video (808 phonk), or the presses can play a song from its MIDI notes.

games.title: Rock Paper Scissors Showdown
games.description: One glowing hero faces a board full of rocks and scissors. Everyone hunts what it beats and flees what beats it, every touch converts the loser, a proportional counter bar tracks the three kinds and the clip zooms in on the hero once a single kind is left. Hero kind, population mix, speeds, art and colours are all customizable.

controls.label: Zoom on the hero at the end
